E_SPAN: least e with CUM_RESP_TAG_e containing all N tags
RESP_TAG_CLOSURE: union over all integer e>=0, proved symbolically rather than guessed from quiet rounds
RESP_TAG_e: tags with any tag-level delta nonzero

tag_predicates.ACTION_SET_DELTA_e(i): 1 iff stationary-rule allowed action set differs
tag_predicates.COUNT_SIGNATURE_DELTA_e(i): 1 iff exact controller-visible local count signature differs
tag_predicates.STATE_DELTA_e(i): 1 iff current tagged relational state/support differs baseline vs perturbed
